title: One hook process per event inside the latency budget (S23)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S23 (Sector 6 — Harness and delivery (ADR 0022)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0022 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector. Counts toward the slop cut t-jgent6a.
Outcome: one `krn hook <event>` entry per event with lazy routes and a timing log; gauge once; shims, subagent-hook-errors, lead-file-read hook and stop-failure deleted; `.codex/hooks.json` generated from the same table
Files: see ADR 0022 Consequences.
Proof: `bin/krn doctor --hooks: tool-call p50 <= 60 ms, p95 <= 150 ms`
Predicted: metric hook-tool-p50-ms <= 60
After: S1
